package.name: s3m_ros2
package.description: ROS2 wrapper around stereo-3d-mot's existing pipeline (stereo depth -> ONNX detection -> 3D promotion -> tracking): subscribes to a stereo image pair, publishes detections, tracks, and a 3D point cloud. Phase 8 (optional/bonus) -- wraps Phases 1-7's already-built, already-verified C++ library; no perception logic lives in this package.
